tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi dka' 'grel gnad kyi snying po gsal byed las spyi dang bye brag brtag pa ste rab byed gsum pa'i rnam par bshad pa bzhugs// spyi dang bye brag nyi ma'i kha lo pa/ kun gsal shes bya'i khyon la myur 'ongs pas/ /tshul min mun rum pha mthar mngon phyogs pa'i/ /lnga rig 'od zer brgya pas bdag skyongs shig /gsum pa blos yul rtogs tshul bshad pa la bzhi/ yul spyi dang bye brag bshad pa/ 'dzin stangs snang ba dang sel ba bshad pa/ grogs brjod bya dang rjod byed bshad pa/ rtsa ba 'gal ba dang 'brel pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ yul dang yul can thun mong bshad/ rdzas ldog don la grub pa dgag /khyad par spyi dang bye brag bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ yul gyi gnas lugs spyir bstan/ de nyid gtan la 'bebs tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang mtshan gsal bar 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ rtog med shes pa yin te/ gsal snang can gyi rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ spyi mtshan mi gsal bar 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ rtog pa yin te/ rang yul don spyi'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ rang mtshan chos can/ dngos po yin te don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir/ spyi mtshan chos can/ dngos por med de/ don byed mi nus yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ rang mtshan 'dzin pa rtog med de/ /zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang / de'i rang 'grel du/ rang gi mtshan nyid dang gsal ba dang / dngos po dang / rdzas dang / ldog pa dang / don dam pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni don byed nus pa/ rdzas phan tshun ma 'dres pa/ rgyu dang 'bras bur grub pa/ skyes bu thams cad kyi blang dor bya ba'i 'jug ldog gi yul yin pas/ dngos po'i don du don gcig pa yin te/ zhes sogs dang / spyi dang / gzhan sel dang / ldog pa dang / rnam dpyod dang / 'dres pa dang / 'brel pa dang / kun rdzob ces bya ba la sogs pa ni/ don la mi gnas pa dngos por ma grub pa dbang po'i yul min pa/

blos sgro btags pa zhes sogs byung / 'o na/ rang 'grel der/ spyi mtshan dang rang mtshan gyi rnam grangs su bshad pa de dag sgra ji bzhin du khas len nus sam snyam na/ 'di la skabs phyed par bya dgos te/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i spyi yin na dngos med yin pas ma khyab kyang / /spyi gsal gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i spyi yin na dngos med yin pas khyab ste/ spyi gsal gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i spyi de spyi mtshan la 'jog pa'i gnad kyis/ de gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i gsal ba de la'ang rang mtshan gyis khyab pa'i phyir/ des na gsal pa de la'ang / bye brag la gsal bar bzhag pa dang / rang mtshan la gsal bar bzhag pa gnyis yod de/ gsal bas zlas drangs pa'i spyi de la spyir bzhag pa gcig dang / spyi mtshan la spyir bzhag pa gcig ste gnyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ log ldog gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i log pa la rang mtshan dang / ldog pa la spyi mtshan gyis khyab ste/ de gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i log pa de rdzas grub dang / ldog pa de gzhan ldog la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir log pa la rang mtshan dang / ldog pa la spyi mtshan gyis ma khyab ste/ chos dang chos can gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i chos can la log pa dang / chos la ldog par 'jog pa'i skabs gcig kyang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir rdzas yod la rang mtshan dang / btags yod la spyi mtshan gyis khyab kyang / mtshan mtshon gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i rdzas yod la de ltar ma khyab ste/ mtshan nyid kyi zlas drangs pa'i btags yod de/ mtshon bya thams cad la 'jog cing mtshon bya'i zlas drangs pa'i rdzas yod de/ mtshan nyid thams cad la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir dngos po dang / rdzas la rang mtshan gyis khyab kyang / dngos po brjod pa'i sgra dang rdzas brjod pa'i sgra zhes pa'i skabs kyi dngos po dang / rdzas ni khyad chos dang / khyad gzhi gnyis la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /don gyi gnad 'di/

sa paṇ+ṭitas dgongs pa bla na med pa yin te/ rang 'grel las/ 'o na de la'ang gzhan las ldog pa dang / gzhan las log pa zhes bya ba/ zhes bya ba dang / kun la rdzas dang dngos brjod pa'i/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te log pa dang dngos po ni/ don la gnas pa dang sel ba'i yul du gyur pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na kho bo gzhung bzhin 'chad par 'dod/ ces pa'i 'grel pa rab byed bcu gsum ma las/ ldog pa dang spyi dang bye brag dang gzhan sel la sogs pa ni don la mi gnas pas/ blos sgro btags pa/ snang mi snang cha gnyis med pa zhes sogs kyi sgra zin la/ ldog pa dang / spyi bye brag sogs thams cad la dngos med kyis khyab par bshad pa ma yin nam snyam na/ skyon med de/ ldog pa la dngos med kyis khyab par bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ log ldog gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i ldog pa de la dgongs pa yin la/ spyi dang bye brag sogs la dngos med du bshad pa ni/ song tshod kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ rlom tshod la bum pa de/ gser bum gyi spyir rlom yang / song tshod la/ rtog ngor bum min bcad nas bum par snang tsam de de'i spyir song ba'i phyir dang / song tshod la rtog ngor gser bum ma yin pa bsal tsam de de'i bye brag tu song ba'i phyir ro/ /gnad 'di go dgos te/ 'og nas mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum char la/ spyi mtshan gyis khyab par bshad pa yang / song tshod kyi mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum la dgongs so/ /zhes kho bos 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ yul rdzas dang ldog pa/ spyi dang bye brag /'dzin stangs snang ba dang sel ba/ yul can rtog mi rtog rnam gzhag chos can/ khyod 'chad pa'i tshul yod de/ phyogs glang yab sras kyi gzhung bzhin du/ ma 'chol bar so sor 'chad pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ rdzas dang ldog pa spyi bye brag /ces sogs sh+lo ka gcig go/

/rtsa ba'i gnyis pa ni/ rjes dpag chos can/ khyod bum pa'i steng gi byas mi rtag gi rdzas kyi cha la snang bas 'jug pa ma yin te/ khyod la de sgrub pas 'jug pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na khyod bum pa'i steng gi byas mi rtag gi ldog cha so sor phye nas 'jug ste/ khyod de la sel 'jug yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa ni/ rjes dpag dngos po mi 'dzin pas/ zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig go/ /'dir rang 'grel las/ rdzas ldog don la grub pa dgag /ces pa'i sa bcad mdzad pa ni/ rdzas rang mtshan pa don la grub pa 'gog pa ma yin gyi/ ldog pa du ma 'dus pa'i gzhi shes 'dod chos can la rdzas dang ldog pa so so'i khyad chos la ldog par bshad nas/ khyad gzhi gang yin rdzas mtshan nyid par cha bsdus pas 'dod pa de 'gog pa ste gnad go dgos so/ /gsum pa spyi bye brag bshad pa la/ gzhung gi tshig don bshad pa/ de nyid rigs pas gtan la phab pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos po chos can/ khyod rigs mi mthun dngos med las ldog pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang yin pa de/ khyod dngos po'i spyi yin pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i don ldog yin pa'i phyir/ bem po chos can/ khyod dngos por rigs mi mthun pa dngos med las kyang ldog /dngos por rigs mthun pa shes pa las kyang log pa'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs yin pa de khyod dngos po'i bye brag yin pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i don ldog yin pa'i phyir/ spyi bye brag gnyis chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis gnyis yod de/ thad ka'i spyi bye brag gnyis dang gong ma'i spyi bye brag gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ thad ka'i bye brag sha pa dang tsan+dan gnyis chos can/ rdzas tha dad yin te/ rgyu rkyen tha dad las skyes shing / log pa'i dngos po so so ba yin pa'i phyir/ gong ma'i bye brag tsan+dan skad cig ma snga phyi gnyis chos can/ gcig pa bkag pa'i tha dad yin te/ khyod gnyis gcig dngos por grub dus gcig shos dngos por med pa'i phyir/

zhes 'chad pa ni/ gzhan dang rang gi dngos po las/ zhes sogs sh+lo ka phyed dang gnyis so/ /gnyis pa de nyid gtan la phabs pa la/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed g.yag rong rnam gnyis ni/ 'grel pa'i sgra zin/ spyi bye brag sogs la/ rtag pas khyab pa zhal gyis bzhes te/ de'i gnad kyis gzugs sgra sogs kyang spyi yin pas rtag pa yin no/ /zhes bzhed/ phyis byon/ sdom rigs gnyis kyi bstan pa'i gces mdzod skyong ba go shāg rnam gnyis ni/ 'grel pa'i sgra zin spyi bye brag ldog pa sogs la spyi mtshan gyis khyab par zhal gyis bzhes shing / gzugs sgra sogs ni spyi ma yin no zhes bzhed/ des na mkhas pa 'di gnyis ni/ bstan bcos 'di nyid kyi bshad srol rma med par skyong ba'i skyes bu mchog dam pa yin la/ 'jigs bral bo dong pa chen po ni/ bstan bcos 'di 'gog pa la mkhas par rlom pa'i phyir rgol ba yin pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa 'di gsum gyi gsung gi zegs ma ni 'bel ba'i gtam gyis gtan la dbab pa'i 'os yin gyi/ gzhan dag gis blo gros kyi snyigs ma bsdus pa'i phung po la dgag sgrub kyis ngal ba ni/ dal 'byor gyi snying po sbun pas zad par byas pa yin pa'i phyir btang snyoms su bya bar rigs so/ /de la mkhas mchog don dang ldan pa kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pas sde bdun rab gsal las 'di ltar bshad de/ sngar gyi 'grel pa'i sgra zin rnams don gcig tu bshad nas/ thun mong bar snang ba'i sgro btags spyi'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na rigs spyi/ don spyi/ tshogs spyi gsum/ mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin/ rang gi gsal ba rnams la ltos nas/ rigs mi mthun las bzlog pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang du snang ba'i sgro btags de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ snang btags gcig tu 'khrul ba'i sgro btags gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rdul rdzas du ma 'dus pa las rags par snang ba'i sgro btags gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/

des na chos de'i bye brag yin na/ chos de yin pas ma khyab ste/ shing 'dzin rtog pa la snang ba'i sha pa'i don spyi de/ shing spyi la ltos nas bye brag yin kyang / shing spyi ma yin yin pa bzhin no/ /khyod chos de'i spyi yin na/ chos de khyod yin pas kyang ma khyab ste/ shing gi ldog pa de shing gi spyi yin yang / shing de de'i ldog pa ma yin pa bzhin no/ /deng sang bod rnams dngos po yin na khyod khyod kyi ldog pa ma yin pa bud ces dang / khyod gzhi grub na khyod kyi ldog pa khyod kyi ldog pa de yin pa bud/ ces dang / khyod gzhi grub na khyod kyi spyi de khyod kyi spyi yin pa bud/ ces pa ni/ chos grags kyis bkag pa de nyid snying nad byas nas khas len pa yin pas/ kho bo ni de gsum 'gal khyab la 'bud do/ /zhes bya ba bris so/ /don 'di dag la/ tshig tsam ma yin pa'i rnam par dpyod pa cung zad bgyid pas snyan gtod cig /'o na sha pa'i don spyi de/ shing spyi'i bye brag yin nam/ shing gi bye brag yin/ gang ltar yang skyon gnas te/ dang po ltar yin gsungs na/ sha pa'i don spyi chos can/ khyod shing spyi'i bye brag yin par thal/ 'dod na khyod spyi mtshan gyi bye brag yin par thal/ khyod shing spyi'i bye brag gang zhig /spyi yin na spyi mtshan yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na ma yin par thal/ khyod rang mtshan gyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod shing gi bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod rtog ngor shing min las kyang log /shing gi nang tshan tsan+dan las kyang log pa'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ gzhan dang rang gi dngos po las/ /ldog par byed pa spyi bye brag /ces pa'i gzhung don dor bar 'gyur la/ rtags gnyis khyod la grub ste/ sha pa'i don spyi de/ rtog pa la shing dang sha pa gnyis char du snang ba'i phyir/ gal te spyi mtshan gyi bye brag ma yin par thal/ rang mtshan gyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir la ma khyab zer na/

de la khyab pa yod par thal/ dngos po'i bye brag yin na/ dngos med kyi bye brag ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sha pa'i don spyi chos can/ de gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yin par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na nyon cig /sha pa chos can/ khyod 'dzin rtog pa la dngos po'i rnam par snang bar thal/ khyod kyi don spyi de dngos po'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mi snang bar thal/ khyod 'dzin rtog pa la khyod dngos med kyi rnam par snang ba'i phyir te/ khyod kyi don spyi dngos med kyi bye brag yin pa gang zhig /dngos po'i bye brag yin na dngos po yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma 'di rang la log dogs tsam ma gtogs/ phyogs snga ma'i 'dod la rtags phyi ma 'di mi dgos so/ /mdor na sha pa'i don spyi chos can/ khyod dngos med kyi gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod gzhan sel gang zhig /khyod rtog pa la dngos po yin pa bcad nas dngos med du snang ba'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ khyod rtog pa la dngos med ma yin las log /dngos med kyi nang tshan 'ga' zhig las kyang log par snang ba'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod dngos med kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod dngos po'i gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te sha pa'i don spyi de dngos med kyi bye brag min zer na/ de chos can/ khyod dngos med kyi bye brag yin par thal/ khyod don spyi'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod khyod 'dzin rtog pa la don spyi ma yin pa las kyang log /don spyi'i nang tshan tsan dan gyi don spyi las kyang log par snang ba'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs yin pa'i phyir/ yang gal te sha pa'i don spyi de/ shing gi bye brag yin no zer na/ khyod rang gi grub mtha'i babs la yang de ltar zer dgos par snang mod/ skyon 'di ltar gnas te/ de chos can/ khyod shing gi bye brag ma yin par thal/

khyod shing ma yin pa'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod don spyi'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags sngar ltar ro/ /yang de chos can/ khyod shing gi nang tshan yin par thal ba dang / shing gi mtshan gzhi yin par thal/ khyod shing gi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa kho bos 'cha' zhing / 'dod na shing yin par thal lo/ /yang de chos can/ khyod shing dang sha pa'i gzhi mthun yin par thal/ khyod shing gi bye brag yin pa gang zhig /bye brag dang gzhi mthun gnyis don gcig tu khyed rang gi sde bdun rab gsal las bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na khyod shing yin par thal/ khyod shing dang sha pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gsal dngos shing khyab pa bdag gis bcas so/ /don dril na/ shing gi bye brag la shing yin mi dgos pa dang / shing dang sha pa'i gzhi mthun la shing yin mi dgos zhes smra ba ni seng ga'i wa skad yin par mngon no/ /yang ma 'dres pa'i don spyi chos can/ khyod thun mong bar snang ba'i sgro btags yin par thal/ khyod yin na/ de yin pas khyab pa mtshan nyid kyis bshags pa'o/ /'dod na ma yin par thal/ khyod thun mong ma yin par snang ba'i sgro btags yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod ma 'dres par snang ba'i sgro btags yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod ma 'dres pa'i don spyi yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bum pa'i don spyi yin na/ bum par snang ba'i sgro btags yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang gzugs kyi skye mched chos can/ khyod spyi mtshan yin par thal/ khyod rags pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos ma grub na der thal/ khyod bem po gang zhig /rdul phran ma yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ khyod cha med kyi rdul phran min pa gang zhig /cha bcas kyi rdul phran yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma ma grub na/ khyod rags pa yin par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod gzung don ma yin par thal lo/ /gal te cha med yin yang zla med min zer na/ gzung don chos can/

khyod 'dzin dbang sngon la khyod rdul phran gyi rnam par snang bar thal/ khyod khyod 'dzin dbang mngon gyi gzung don gang zhig /khyod rdul phran yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod khyod 'dzin dbang mngon la rags pa'i rnam par snang ba'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'di la mkhas pa chen po na re/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon la/ gzugs rags pa'i rnam par snang yang / rags par mi snang rdul phran du snang zer ro/ /'di khyod kyis rags pa rdzas su ma grub par khas blangs pa'i rang skyon yin pas nyon cig /gzugs chos can/ khyod khyod 'dzin dbang mngon la rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed min par thal/ khyod rdul phran gang zhig /khyod 'dzin dbang mngon la khyod rags pa'i rnam par snang ba'i phyir/ rtags rnams dngos so/ /khyab pa gzur gnas kyis dpyod cig /'dod mi nus te/ khyod gzung don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bod snga phyi phal cher gyi yongs khyab gsum/ khyod kyis 'gal khyab la/ 'bud pa de la/ rim bzhin gson cig /dngos po chos can/ khyod khyod kyi ldog pa ma yin par thal/ khyod dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod der thal/ khyod dngos po'i rang ldog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rtog pa rtog pa'i rang ldog gang zhig /mngon sum mngon sum gyi rang ldog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ rang 'grel las/ bral ba'i don rtog pa'i rdzas la byas na/ rtog pa myong ba'i rang rig rtog bral ma yin par 'gyur la/ rtog pa'i ldog pa la byas na rjes dpag kyang rtog bral 'gyur bas zhes sogs dang / sgro 'dogs gcod pa mngon sum gyi rang ldog la mi srid par bshad zin to/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'di'i dogs gcod gzhan sel brtag par 'chad/ yang dngos po chos can/ khyod kyi ldog pa/ khyod kyi ldog pa yin par thal/ khyod gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ 'gal khyab gnyis pa bshags pa'o/ /'dod na/ dngos po'i ldog pa chos can/ khyod dngos po ma yin pa las log pa yin par thal/

khyod dngos po'i ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod dngos por thal lo/ /yang dngos po chos can/ khyod kyi spyi khyod kyi spyi yin par thal/ khyod gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ 'gal khyab gsum pa bshags pa'o/ /'dod na/ khyod dngos po'i gsal ba rnams kyi rigs mi mthun las ldog pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang yin par thal/ khyod dngos po'i spyi yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khyed rang gis spyi'i mtshan nyid steng du dngos/ 'dod na/ khyod dngos po'i rigs mi mthun las log pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang yin par thal lo/ /'dod na/ khyod dngos po ma yin pa las log pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang yin par thal lo/ /'dod na khyod dngos po ma yin pa las log par thal lo/ /yang bum pa'i spyi chos can/ khyod bum pa la rjes su 'gro bar thal/ khyod bum pa'i spyi yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ khyab pa tshad mas grub cing / khyod rang gis khas blangs te/ sde bdun rab gsal las/ bum 'dzin rtog pa de yang gzhan sel mtshan nyid pa min te/ bum pa'i gzhan sel yin na/ bum pa la rjes su 'gro dgos pa gang zhig /de bum pa la rjes su mi 'gro ba'i phyir/ zhes bshad 'dug pa'i phyir/ yang sha pa dang tsan+dan gnyis chos can/ spyi mtshan yin par thal/ bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ thad ka'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ /de der thal/ thad ka'i bye brag yod pa gang zhig /rtog ngo'i sha pa dang tsan+dan gnyis po de yang min/ de las gzhan pa'ang med pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ rtog ngo'i de gnyis rdzas tha dad yin par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rtog ngo'i sha pa dang tsan+dan rdzas su grub par thal lo/ /yang dbang mngon chos can/ spyi mtshan yin par thal/ bye brag yin pa'i phyir te/ mngon sum gyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ gcig phyir brtsad pa'i skyon las grol/ /zhes pa'i rang 'grel las/ mngon sum gyi bye brag dbang mngon dang tha dad kyang /

bye brag rang rig dang gcig pas skyon gnyis pa las grol lo zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /dpal shākya mchog ldan gyis/ rtog ge snying po las/ spyi de la spyi gsal gyi zlas drangs pa'i spyi dang / spyi bye brag gi zlas drangs pa'i spyi gnyis las/ spyi dang po de dang ldog pa gzhan sel don gcig /gsal ba de dang log pa rang mtshan don gcig /spyi gnyis pa de'i mtshan nyid ni/ ldog pa chig rkyang de de'i mtshan nyid/ ldog pa gnyis tshogs de bye brag gi mtshan nyid/ de dang gzhi mthun don gcig /'dir kho de'i spyi yin na/ de kho'i bye brag yin pas ma khyab ste/ sel ngor bum min bsal tsam de bum pa'i spyi yin yang / de de'i bye brag min pa bzhin no/ /yang de kho'i bye brag yin na/ kho de'i spyi yin dgos te/ sel ngo'i gser bum dang de'i bum pa bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba bris so/ /de la dgag pa phal cher ni/ sngar bshad pa las rtogs nus shing / cung zad brjod na/ khyod kyis spyi gsal gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i spyi dang / spyi dang bye brag gi zlas phye ba'i spyi gnyis so sor 'byed pa de mi 'thad par thal/ spyi yin na/ spyi gsal gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i spyi yang yin/ spyi bye brag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i spyi yang yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ spyi yin na gzhan sel yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ phyi ma der thal/ spyi yin na ldog pa chig rkyang yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ spyi yang yin/ ldog pa chig rkyang ma yin pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun khas len mi rigs pa'i phyir/ ma grub na gang yin smros shig /yang sha pa'i don spyi chos can/ shing de khyod kyi spyi yin par thal/ khyod shing gi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ ma grub na/ shes bya chos can/ de der thal/ shing gi bye brag khas len rigs/ sha pa de de ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ shing gi nang tshan du ma khas len rigs pa'i phyir/

rtsa bar 'dod na/ shing chos can/ khyod spyi mtshan yin par thal/ khyod spyi yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ rang gi lugs la/ spyi la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ shing shing min las log pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang du snang ba de/ shing spyi yin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ ming gi sgo nas dbye na/ rigs spyi/ tshogs spyi/ don spyi dang gsum/ dang po dang spyi gnyis don gcig cing / gnyis pa la spyi yin min gnyis yod/ gsum pa don spyi la yang spyi yin min gnyis yod do/ /bye brag gi sgo nas dbye na/ thad ka'i spyi dang / gong ma'i spyi gnyis so/ /bye brag la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sha pa shing min las kyang log /tsan+dan las kyang log pa'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs yin pa de/ sha pa bye brag yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na thad ka'i bye brag dang / gong ma'i bye brag gnyis so/ /des na gsal ba'i zlas drangs pa'i spyi ni/ spyi mtshan gyi ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ bye brag gi zlas drangs pa'i spyi ni spyi mtshan nyid pa yin pas/ kho spyi yin pa la/ kho'i bye brag yod dgos pa dang / kho bye brag yin pa la kho'i spyi yod dgos shing / bye brag de spyi yin dgos so/ /zhes shes par byed dgos la/ 'on kyang / chos de'i bye brag yin na/ chos de yin/ chos de dang bdag gcig tu 'brel ba sogs khyad chos gsum ldan dgos pa ni/ cha bsdus pa kho na'i lugs yin gyi/ shes byed kyi lung rigs ci yang med cing / chos de'i bye brag yin pa la/ chos de yin pa dang / kho ma yin zhing / chos de yin pa gcig tsam tshang ba gang zhig nges par dgos te/ bye brag la ldog pa nyis tshogs dgos shing / ldog pa nyis tshogs pa la gnad de nges par tshang dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dngos po'i 'bras bu lta bu yang / dngos po'i bye brag tu byed dgos te/ de dngos po la ltos pa'i ldog pa nyis tshogs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/gsum pa khyad chos gtan la phab pa la gsum/ rdzas grub 'dod pa'i gzhan lugs dgag /sel bar 'dod pa'i rang lugs bzhag /de la gzhan gyi rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ spyi gsal tha dad 'dod pa dgag /cha med rdzas gcig yin pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mu stegs bye brag pa/ yod pa nyid lta bu spyi chen po dang / ba glang nyid lta bu'i nyi tshe ba'i spyi gnyis rang rang gi gsal ba dang rdzas tha dad 'dod cing / de yang spyi gsal gnyis po ba glang thag pas sbrel ba lta bur 'dod do/ /de dgag pa ni/ rang gi gsal ba las rdzas tha dad pa'i spyi chos can/ dngos por med de/ der snang rung tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ tha dad snang rung med pas khegs/ zhes pa 'di byung / gnyis pa la/ spyi gcig rdzas gcig yin pa dgag /du ma rdzas gcig yin pa dgag /mtshungs pa'i spyi gcig yin pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la mu stegs grangs can pa/ rdul phran mun pa snying stobs gsum cha snyoms pa'i spyi gtso bo ni/ rang gi gsal ba rnam 'gyur rnams dang cha med rdzas gcig tu 'dod pa la/ de bzhin du cha bsdus rjes 'brang rnams kyang / spyi dang bye brag cha med rdzas gcig tu 'dod do/ /'di dgag pa la gsum/ snang rung ma dmigs rtags kyis dgag /rigs pas rnam par brtags te dgag /ha cang thal ba'i gnod byed bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shing gsal rnams dang / cha med rdzas gcig pa'i shing spyi chos can/ med de snang rung tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sha pa dang / yul dus rnam pa 'gal ba'i shing gsal kun chos can/ khyod shing dang skye 'jig cig char byed par thal/ khyod shing dang cha med rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shing chos can/ khyod sha pa dang skye 'jig cig char du mi byed par thal/ khyod sha pa'i snga logs kyi tsan+dan dang skye 'jig cig char byed pa'i phyir/ rtags gsal dngos/ rtsa bar ma khyab na/ de 'dra'i shing gsal chos can/

khyod shing dang cha med rdzas gcig ma yin par thal/ khyod dang shing gnyis la skye 'jig cig char byed mi byed kyi cha du ma yod pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa ni/ rdzas gcig na yang snang rung min/ /zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang rkang pa gcig go/ /gsum pa ni/ 'o na yan lag dang cha med rdzas gcig pa'ang 'gog mi nus par thal/ spyi gsal cha med rdzas gcig pa 'gog mi nus pa gang zhig /de gnyis 'gog pa'i rigs pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ yang sha pa 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon chos can/ khyod la shing gsal kun dang cha med rdzas gcig pa'i shing spyi de gsal bar snang bar thal/ khyod sha pa gsal bar snang ba'i mngon sum gang zhig /shing spyi de sha pa dang cha med rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dod na/ khyod rtog pa yin par thal/ khyod shing gsal rnams dang cha med rdzas gcig pa'i shing spyi 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gal te de la ma khyab ste/ shing gsal kun dang cha med rdzas gcig pa'i shing gi don spyi 'dzin na rtog par 'gyur gyi shing gsal kun dang cha med rdzas gcig pa'i shing gi rigs spyi 'dzin pas rtog par yang mi 'gyur ba'i phyir zer na/ mi 'thad de/ don spyir ma 'dus pa'i de 'dra'i rigs spyi 'dod pa ni/ chur ma 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho 'dod pa ltar/ slob dpon ngan pa'i dug chus myos pa'i klag col yin pa'i phyir/ yang sha pa de tsan dan dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ sha pa de tsan dan dang cha med rdzas gcig pa'i shing spyi dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ spyi dang bye brag rdzas gcig na/ zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang / rang 'grel las/ don spyi 'dzin na rtog pa yin gyi/ rigs spyi 'dzin pa ma yin no snyam na/ don spyir ma 'dus pa'i/ rigs spyi 'dod pa ni/ chu ma yin pa'i rgya mtsho 'dod pa ltar/ slob dpon ngan pa'i dug chus myos pa'i klag col yin no zhes sogs 'byung ngo / /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa/ spyi du ma bye brag dang cha med gcig tu 'dod pa dgag pa ni/

bye brag re re dang 'brel ba'i/ zhes sogs so/ gsum pa/ mtshungs pa'i spyi dgag pa ni/ mtshan nyid mtshungs pa'i spyi gcig dang / /zhes sogs so/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa ni/ rtog ngor dngos po min pa rnam par bsal tsam chos can/ khyod sel ba'i spyi yin te/ dngos po kun la rjes su 'gro ba'i don spyi yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa ni/ de min rang bzhin las ldog pa/ /zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig go/ /gsum pa rtsod spang ni/ 'o na bye brag grub pas spyi grub pa rang bzhin gyi rtags dang / spyi khegs pas bye brag khegs pa khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi rnam gzhag mi 'thad par thal/ rtog ngor dngos po min pa bsal nas/ dngos por snang tsam de/ sgro btags yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab ste/ song tshod la spyi bye brag sgro btags su song yang / song tshod kyi spyi bye brag spyi mtshan la/ rlom tshod kyi spyi bye brag rang mtshan par rlom nas/ zhugs pas 'jug yul rang mtshan thob nus pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa ni/ gal te don la spyi med na/ /zhes sogs sh+lo ka gnyis so/ /des na spyi bye brag gi rnam bzhag la 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi rnam dbye 'chad tshul yod de/ 'chad 'jug dang rlom song so sor ma phye bar/ spyi gsal rdzas tha dad du 'dod pa 'ug phrug pa'am bye brag pa'i lugs/ de gnyis cha med rdzas gcig tu 'dod pa grangs can pa dang cha bsdus pa'i lugs yin zhing / 'jug tshe dang rlom tshod kyi bye brag la rang mtshan yod srid kyang / 'tshad tshe dang song tshod kyi spyi bye brag /gzhan sel kho nar 'jog pa mkhas pa sa paṇa bdag gi lugs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ tha dad spyi 'dod 'ug phrug pa/ /zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig byung ngo / /'dir nye bar mkho ba'i dogs pa cung zad dpyad na/ grangs can 'gog pa'i zhar la/ rang 'grel las/ yang bod rnams shing sha pa dang tsan dan la sogs pa'i bye brag la shing tsam zhes bya ba'i spyi dang /

bai ḍūr+ya la sogs pa'i sngon po'i bye brag rnams la sngon po tsam zhes bya ba'i spyi dang / de bzhin du ba glang tsam zhes bya ba'i spyi rnams/ bye brag rnams la ngo bo dbyer med kyi gcig tu yod do zhes kha mthun par sgrog go/ /'di skad 'dod pa'i grangs can pa dang bod rnams don mthun no/ /zhes sogs dang / rdzas gcig yin zhes grangs can pa/ /gangs can pa rnams de rjes 'brang / /zhes sogs kyi sgra zin la/ shing dang sha pa spyi bye brag tu khas blangs nas/ de gnyis rdzas gcig tu 'dod pas/ grangs can dang thun mong ba'i phyogs sngar byas nas/ de 'gog pa la/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag dang / skye 'jig cig char byed par thal ba la sogs pa'i rigs pa'i rnam grangs du ma zhig bkod pa dang / gzhan sel brtag par/ 'di la bod rnams phal cher ni/ /dngos po'i ldog pa dngos por 'dod/ /de lta yin na spyi yi skyon/ /brjod pa 'di ni gdon par dka'/ /zhes dngos po tsam zhig dngos por khas blangs na/ spyi gsal rdzas gcig dang tha dad 'gog pa'i rigs pa rnams rang la ldog pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa la/ g.yag rong sogs 'ga' zhig /sgra zin ltar/ dngos po tsam dang shing tsam sogs rtag par zhal gyis bzhes/ phyis kyi 'ga' zhig /dngos med du gyur pa'i spyi gsal rdzas gcig pa bkag pa yin gyi/ dngos por gyur pa'i de bkag pa med do/ /zhes 'chol gtam smra/ kha cig dngos por gyur pa la yang spyi gsal dbyer med rdzas gcig pa dang grub sde rdzas gcig pa sogs bkag pa yin no/ /zhes 'khyog 'gros tsam zhig 'don par mdzad pa la/ kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang pos sde bdun gsal las/ gzhan lugs 'gog tshul/ rang lugs 'jog tshul/ skyon spong tshul sogs 'di ltar bshad de/ spyi gsal rdzas gcig 'dod pa la/ ngo bo rgyu skye 'jig la brtags te dgag pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ shing spyi de sha pa'i rdzas yin nam min/

min na de de dang rdzas gcig ma yin par thal/ de de'i rdzas min pa'i phyir/ yin na shug pa de shing ma yin par thal/ shing spyi de sha pa'i rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni shing spyi de sha pa'i rgyu las skyes sam ma skyes/ ma skyes na shing spyi chos can/ sha pa dang rdzas gcig ma yin par thal/ de'i rgyu las ma skyes pa'i phyir/ skyes na sha pa'i rgyu khegs na/ khyod khegs dgos par thal lo/ /gsum pa ni/ sha pa skye 'jig byed pa'i tshe/ shing spyi skye 'jig byed dam mi byed/ /mi byed na shing spyi dang rdzas gcig ma yin par thal lo/ /byed na sha pa skye 'jig byed pa'i tshe/ sha pa dang yul dus rnam pa 'gal ba'i shing gsal rnams kyang skye 'jigs byed par thal/ de rnams dang rdzas gcig pa'i shing spyi skye 'jig byed pa'i phyir/ de ltar gzhan lugs bkag nas/ rang lugs ni spyi bye brag rnams la dngos med kyis khyab/ shing dang gzugs sgra spyi min no zhes bshad/ de la sngar gyi skyon spong tshul ni/ 'o na shing rdzas su grub na/ sha pa dang rdzas gcig gam tha dad gang yin zhe na/ 'o na tshad ma de mngon sum dang rjes dpag gang yin/ zhes 'dri bar bya'o/ /gal te rtog par gyur pa'i tshad ma rjes dpag dang / rtog med du gyur pa'i tshad ma mngon sum yin zhing / de gnyis las gzhan pa'i tshad ma mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe na/ 'o na sha par gyur/ pa'i shing sha pa dang rdzas gcig sha pa min par gyur pa'i shing sha pa dang rdzas gzhan yin zhing / de gnyis las gzhan pa'i shing mi srid do/ /zhes mtshungs so/ /ces sogs dang / gzhan yang spyi gsal cha med rdzas gcig pa dang / dbyer med rdzas gcig pa dang / grub sde rdzas gcig pa bkag pa yin no/ /zer ba sogs la'ang skyon brjod pa'i grub don la/ rdzas gcig la grub sde rdzas gcig gis ma khyab par khas blangs dag gis ni/ rtag dngos khas blang dgos te/ da lta rdzas gcig tu yod pa'i dngos po gnyis/

skad gcig gnyis par gcig zhig nas/ gcig shos gnas par khas blangs pa'i phyir zhes dang / des na rdzas su grub na rdzas gcig dang / rdzas tha dad gang rung yin pas ma khyab kyang / gong du spyi gsal rdzas gcig dang rdzas tha dad dpyad nas bkag pa'i nyes pa rnams rang la mi mtshungs te/ gzhan gyis ni/ shing de shing gsal rnams la rjes su 'gro ba'i spyi yang yin la/ rdzas su grub pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun du khas blangs la/ kho bos ni shing rdzas grub tu khas blangs kyang shing gsal rnams la rjes su 'gro ba'i spyir khas ma blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa bris shing / dpal shākya mchog ldan gyi rtog snying sogs las kyang / mkhas pa gung mthun du/ rdzas gcig la grub sde rdzas gcig gis khyab pa dang / shing sogs dngos por khas blangs shing / spyi min pa bzhed pa sogs rgyas par bris so/ /don 'di dag la dpyod ldan gyis gzhigs na/ phar la skyon 'phangs pa thams cad rang la yang 'khor te/ 'di la gsum/ mtshungs pa rjes dpyad/ dngos skyon gyis gdong bzlog /gnad kyi gdams pas mtshang brtol ba'o/ /dang po ni 'o na khyed rang la yang / rjes dpag de mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin zhes/ rigs pa'i gter 'dir gsal bar bshad pa la/ ngo bo rgyu skye 'jig brtags pa'i skyon gsum tshur bzlog ste/ 'o na rjes dpag de/ mngon sum gyi rdzas yin nam min/ min na rjes dpag chos can/ mngon sum dang rdzas gcig ma yin par thal/ khyod de'i rdzas ma yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ltar na/ rjes dpag de rtog pa ma yin par thal/ de mngon sum gyi rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ stobs mtshungs 'khor gsum gcig go/ /yang rjes dpag de mngon sum gyi rgyu las skyes sam ma skyes/ ma skyes na/ rjes dpag chos can/ mngon sum dang rdzas gcig ma yin par thal/ de'i rgyu las ma skyes pa'i phyir/ gsum char e dran/ skyes na/ mngon sum de yang rjes dpag gi rgyu las skyes par thal/

mngon rjes gnyis rdzas gcig gang zhig /'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon sum chos can/ rjes dpag gi rgyu khegs na/ khyod khegs dgos par thal/ khyod de'i rgyu las skyes pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyud gang la rjes dpag khegs na mngon sum yang khegs dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sang 'chi rgyu la mngon sum khegs par thal/ de'i rgyud la rjes dpag khegs pa'i phyir ro/ /stobs mtshungs 'khor gsum gnyis pa'o/ /yang rjes dpag de mngon sum dang skye 'jig cig char byed dam mi byed/ mi byed na rjes dpag mngon sum dang rdzas gcig ma yin par thal/ de dang skye 'jig cig char mi byed pa'i phyir/ gsum char dran par gyis shig /byed na/ rjes dpag 'jig pa'i tshe na/ rjes dpag dang yul dus 'gal ba'i mngon sum thams cad kyang 'jig par thal/ rjes dpag 'jig pa'i tshe mngon sum 'jig pa'i phyir/ stobs mtshungs gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa dang / dngos skyon gyis gdong ldog pa ni/ 'o na khyed rang la shing chos can/ khyod sha pa dang skye 'jig cig char du byed par thal/ khyod sha pa dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyed rang gis sngar 'phangs pa'i skyon thams cad gar song dran par mdzod cig /rtags ma grub na/ shing chos can/ khyod sha pa dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ khyod de dang grub sde rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de dang grub sde rdzas gcig dang / khyod de dang grub sde rdzas gcig gi zlas phye ba'i rdzas tha dad gang rung yin/ phyi ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod sha pa dang / dngos rgyu gcig las skyes pa dang / tha dad las skyes pa gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyu dang shes pa'i dbye ba yis/ /tha dad tha dad min bzhag byed/ /ces pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ sha pa de shing ma yin par thal/ shing de sha pa dang / rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'di don gyis khas blangs so/

/gzhan yang / shing de sha pa dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ sha pa de shing dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sha pa de shing dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ dbang mngon de mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbang mngon de dbang mngon nyams myong gi rang rig dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rjes dpag de rjes dpag nyams myong gi rang rig dang rdzas gcig yin na/ rjes dpag de mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ rjes dpag yul min rang rig dang / /gcig phyir brtsad pa'i skyon las grol/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gal te/ sha pa de shing dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir la/ ma khyab na/ 'o na sha pa chos can/ khyod shing dang skye 'jig cig car byed par thal/ khyod shing dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod rang la dngos 'gal yang yin mod/ skyon gsar pa 'di ltar 'char ste/ sha pa de shing dang rdzas gcig ma yin par thal/ sha pa skad cig dang po de yang shing dang rdzas gcig ma yin/ sha pa skad cig gnyis pa de yang shing dang rdzas gcig ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis char ma grub na/ sha pa skad cig dang po chos can/ khyod shing dang skye 'jig cig car byed par thal/ khyod de dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khyed rang gi rtsar khyab bzang shos lags so/ /'dod na/ sha pa skad cig dang po chos can/ shing de khyod dang dus mnyam du skyes par thal/ khyod shing dang skye 'jig cig char byed pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shing de sha pa skad cig dang po dang dus mnyam du ma skyes par thal/ shing de sha pa skad cig gnyis pa dang dus mnyam du skyes pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sha pa ska cig gnyis pa chos can/ shing de khyod dang dus mnyam du skyes par thal/ khyod shing dang skye 'jig cig car du byed pa'i phyir te/ khyod shing dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum e dran/ gal te/ dbang mngon de mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir la ma khyab pa na yang khyad par gtan nas med de/

dbang mngon chos can/ khyod mngon sum dang skye 'jig cig char byed par thal/ khyod mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dbang sngon skad cig dang po de yang / mngon sum dang skye 'jig cig char byed/ dbang mngon skad cig gnyis pa de yang / mngon sum dang skye 'jig cig char byed par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig /de gnyis ka mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtags sla zhing / 'dod na 'khor gsum sngar ltar ro/ /yang sha pa chos can/ khyod shing dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ khyod shing dang ngo bo gcig yin pa gang zhig /khyod rdzas su grub pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod shing dang bdag nyid gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod shing dang bdag gcig tu 'brel ba'i phyir te/ khyod sha pa dang ldan pa'i shar gzhir shing yod par bsgrub pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ rnam dpyod dang ldan pa yod na lan thob cig /khyed rang la nyes pa spong lugs de yang rnam par dag pa min te/ shing rdzas su grub na sha pa dang rdzas gcig dang tha dad gang yin rtsod pa'i lan du/ tshad ma de mngon rjes dpag gang yin/ zhes sogs dris nas/ grub don du/ rdzas su grub na rdzas gcig dang / rdzas tha dad gang rung yin pas ma khyab/ tshad ma yin na mngon sum dang rjes dpag gang rung yin pas ma khyab gsungs pa ni mkhas pa'i gtam ma yin te/ shing rdzas su grub kyang / sha pa dang rdzas gcig dang tha dad gang rung du khas blangs mi dgos na/ shing spyi dngos po ba khas blangs pa la/ sha pa dang rdzas gcig dang tha dad gang yin dpyad nas/ skyon 'phangs pa'i nus pa thams cad nyams/ tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nges pa'i nus pa nyams pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po grub ste/ phyogs snga mas kyang / shing spyi dngos por grub kyang / sha pa dang rdzas gcig dang tha dad gang rung min zhes khas blangs na/ khyod la gnod byed brjod rgyu ci yang mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gal te skyon med de/

phyogs snga mas shing de spyi dang rdzas grub gnyis char ru khas blangs/ kho bo cag gis shing rdzas grub tu khas blangs kyang / spyi yin par khas ma blangs pa'i phyir/ zhes sngar ma smras sam snyam na/ smras mod/ de ni tshig gi sgrib g.yogs tsam ma gtogs/ don la dpyod pa'i lan ma yin te/ spyi dang rdzas grub gnyis char yin na/ sha pa dang rdzas gcig dang tha dad gang rung yin dgos/ rdzas grub yin na/ de gang rung yin mi dgos zhes smra ba ni/ khyod rang gis shing spyir khas ma blangs pa'i rgyu mtshan tsam ma gtogs/ don gyi snying po ci yang ma byung 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /khyad par du/ gzhan sel brtag par/ shing min las ldog dngos po de/ /sha pa yin na gzhan shing min/ /gzhan shing yin na sha pa min/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi rigs pa la nus pa gtan nas ma byung bar thal/ shing min las ldog pa'i dngos po chos can/ sha pa dang rdzas gcig dang / tha dad gang rung yin par thal/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di/ gzhung des bstan pa'i don yin pa gang zhig /thal 'gyur de la/ shing chos can du bzung nas 'phangs na/ rang la bar khyab shor 'dug pa'i phyir/ khyod rang la khas blangs nang 'gal gyi 'khor gsum yang 'byung ste/ 'o na shing chos can/ khyod sha pa dang rdzas gcig dang / rdzas tha dad gang rung yin par thal/ khyod sha ba dang rdzas tha dad yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod sha pa dang rgyu rkyen tha dad las skyes pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'gal ba brtag par/ khyod rang gis yang / rgyu rkyen tha dad las skyes pa de rdzas tha dad kyi mtshan nyid yin zhes bshad pa dang dngos 'gal lo/ /ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod kyi dngos rgyu yang yin sha pa'i dngos rgyu yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod sha pa dang dngos rgyu gcig las skye bar thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod sha pa dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khyed rang gis rgyu rkyen gcig las skyes pa de rdzas gcig gi mtshan nyid yin zhes bshad pas 'khor gsum e yin soms shig

/rtsa ba'i rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs ma nges par thal/ mngon rjes gnyis gang rung min pa'i tshad ma phung po gsum pa zhig yod pa'i phyir te/ tshad ma yin na de gang rung yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa gnad kyi gdams pa sbyin pa ni/ 'o na khyod rang la yang sngar gyi nyes pa thams cad bzlog pa min nam snyam na/ kho bo cag la skyon de dag mi bzlog ste/ kho bo cag phyogs snga mas spyi gsal cha med rdzas gcig tu khas blangs pa la skyon de dag 'phangs par 'dod kyis/ spyi gsal rdzas gcig pa tsam la 'phang par mi 'dod de/ de 'dod na/ shing dang sha pa rdzas gcig tha dad gang rung du rang lugs la yang khas blangs dgos pas/ rgol ba gzhan la 'phangs pa'i skyon rang la bzlog pa sngar bshad zin pa'i phyir/ 'dir cha med rdzas gcig zhes pa'i tshig gi sgrib g.yogs tsam ma yin pa'i phyir/ don la yang zer dgos te/ rdzas gcig tsam la skye 'jig cig char byed pa sogs dgos na/ sngar bshad pa'i skyon de dag la lan rnam dag med pa'i phyir/ des na nges par mkho ba'i gnad ni/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i legs bshad dang sbyar na/ rdzas gcig ces pa 'di la rnam grangs bzhir 'byed dgos te/ gzhi mthun srid pa'i rdzas gcig /grub sde rdzas gcig /dbyer med rdzas gcig /rang bzhin rdzas gcig dang bzhir gsal bas so/ /de la dang po ni/ sha pa shing dang rdzas gcig yin pa lta bu ste/ sha pa de shing gi rdzas yin pa'i cha nas sha pa shing dang rdzas gcig ces khas blangs pa tsam yin pas/ rdzas gcig 'di la skye 'jig cig car du byed pa mi dgos te/ sha pa skad cig snga phyi thams cad shing dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na yang shing sha pa dang rdzas gcig min te/ shing de sha pa'i rdzas ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgra'i byas mi rtag rdzas gcig yin pa lta bu ste/ de gnyis dngos rgyu gcig las skyes pa'i phyir ro/

/rdzas gcig 'di la skye 'jig cig car byed pa zhig dgos te/ rgyu gcig las grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ byas mi rtag rdzas gcig pa lta bu ste/ rdzas gcig gang zhig /phan tshun khyab mnyam pa'i phyir ro/ /snga ma dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ /khyab chung ste/ grub sde rdzas gcig la/ dbyer med rdzas gcig gis ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ rjes dpag de/ mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin pa lta bu ste/ rjes dpag de rjes dpag nyams myong gi rang rig dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i cha nas/ mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin par bzhag pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ rjes dpag de mngon sum dang rdzas gcig pa ni/ rang bzhin rdzas gcig pa tsam yin pas/ rdzas gcig 'di la skye 'jig cig char byed pa nges par mi dgos te/ mngon sum gyi snga logs kyi rjes dpag de yang mngon sum dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rjes dpag de/ rjes dpag myong ba'i rang rig dang ni/ skye 'jig cig char byed de/ de de dang grub sde rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang bsdus na/ rang bzhin rdzas gcig dang / grub sde rdzas gcig gnyis su 'dus shing / gnad des na rdzas tha dad pa yang / rdzas gcig tsam gyis zlas drangs pa'i rdzas tha dad gcig dang / grub sde rdzas gcig gis zlas drangs pa'i rdzas tha dad gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ dngos po gang zhig /shing dang rdzas gcig ma yin na/ shing dang rdzas gcig dang tha dad gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i rdzas tha dad yin pas khyab/ gnyis pa ni shing dang dngos rgyu tha dad las skyes na/ shing dang grub sde rdzas gcig dang / rdzas tha dad gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i rdzas tha dad yin pas khyab bo/ /'di gnyis la khyad par ci yod snyam na/ khyad par shin tu che ste/ sha pa de shing dang grub sde rdzas gcig gi zlas phye ba'i rdzas tha dad yin yang / rdzas gcig gi zlas phye ba'i rdzas tha dad ma yin pa'i phyir te/

sha pa de shing dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnad 'di ma go bar/ rdzas gcig la grub de rdzas gcig gis khyab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams la ni/ sha pa shing dang grub sde rdzas gcig tu thal ba dang / rjes dpag mngon sum dang grub sde rdzas gcig tu thal ba'i skyon gnyis 'phangs pas/ zhal rog por gyur to/ /don de dag la dogs pa dpyad na/ khyod dngos po'i bye brag yin par thal/ khyod dngos po ma yin pa las log /dngos po'i nang tshan 'ga' zhig las kyang log pa'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ khyod dngos po'i spyi yin par thal/ khyod dngos po min pa las ldog pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir te/ gzhan dang rang gi dngos po las/ /zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ dngos po chos can kyis bshags/ rtags der thal/ khyod dngos po ma yin pa la log pa'i ldog pa gang zhig /dngos po'i nang tshan ka ba las kyang ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ dngos po min pa las log pa gang zhig /ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa des bsgre'o/ /rtsa bar 'dod na sla/ rtsa bar ma khyab na'ang / dngos po chos can gyis bshags te gtong / yang shing gi don spyi chos can/ khyod dngos po yin par thal/ khyod shing 'dzin rtog ngor dngos po min pa las kyang log /dngos po'i nang tshan bum pa las kyang log par snang ba'i ldog pa gnyis yin pa'i phyir na'ang ma khyab/ dang po der thal/ khyod shing 'dzin rtog ngor dngos po yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de'i ngor shing yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa des bsgre'o/ /yang bum pa'i don spyi chos can/ khyod gser bum gyi spyi yin par thal/ khyod song tshod la gser bum gyi spyi yin pa'i phyir zer na ma khyab/ ma grub na der thal/ bum pa'i don spyi de/ song tshod la gser bum gyi spyir song ba'i phyir ro/

/rtsa bar 'dod na/ gser bum de khyod yin par thal lo/ /yang sha pa chos can/ khyod shing dang rdzas gcig ma yin par thal/ khyod shing dang rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod shing dang grub sde rdzas gcig gi zlas phye ba'i rdzas tha dad yin pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab/ ma grub na der thal/ khyod de dang dngos rgyu tha dad las skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /yang shing gi bye brag yin na/ shing dang rdzas gcig yin pas khyab par thal/ sha pa de shing dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sha pa skad cig gnyis pa chos can gyis bshags/ ma grub na der thal/ khyod shing gi nang tshan gang zhig /khyod shing min las kyang log /shing gi nang tshan/ shing skad cig ma dang po las ldog pa'i log pa gnyis tshogs yin pa'i phyir/ rtags sla/ 'dod mi nus te/ shing dang rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir te/ shing gi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir ro zer na/ ma khyab zer dgos te/ rdzas tha dad de la gnyis yod pa'i rnam dbye phyed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag kyang tshigs su bcad pa'i sdom gyis gnad kyi snying po bsdus na 'di ltar yin te/ chen po'i spyi dang nyi tshe'i spyi la sogs/ /bye brag 'phrod pa 'du ba'i sgo gcig tu/ /dngos po'i gshis la grub par 'dod pa ni/ /phyi rol mu stegs lugs yin 'di na med/ /de yin de 'brel de min grub pa sogs/ /spyi dang bye brag khyad chos gsum ldan ni/ /cha bsdus mkhan pos glo bur sgro btags te/ /phyogs glang grags pa'i gzhung las byung ba min/ /spyi dang bye brag ldog pa chig rkyang dang / /nyis tshogs sgo nas rnam par 'byed shes pa/ /rigs pa'i gzhung lugs bcud kyi snying po ste/ /'jam mgon sa skya pa de'i legs bshad yin/ /grangs can cha bsdus bsres pa'i grub mtha' la/ /skye 'jig cig car la sogs mi 'dra ba'i/ /rigs pa'i rnam 'gyur mang pos bsal ba 'di/ /sa skya lo tsā kho na'i rnam dpyod rtsal/ /tsan dan sha pa la sogs nang tshan la/

/thun mong rjes 'gro byed pa'i shing tsam zhig /rdzas su grub par 'dod na rang phyogs la'ang / /rigs pa'i mtshon cha rang la mi 'khor ram/ /'di nyid rang la bzlog pa'i nyes mthong nas/ /gzugs sgra la sogs rdzas grub min no zhes/ /sa lo'i rjes zhugs byed par mngon rlom pa'i/ /g.yag rong la sogs 'jig rten mes po smra/ /'o na 'chad na gnyis su yod mod kyi/ /'jug tshe gnyis kyi rnam dbye med ces pa'i/ /'jam mgon gsung gi bdud rtsi za ma tog /lha min mdzes ldan gzhon nus brkus sam ci/ /go shāg nyi zla zung gi gsung zer las/ /sngar gyi nyes pa zol gyis sgrib pa'i phyir/ /tsan dan la sogs shing gi nang tshan rnams/ /shing dang rdzas gcig rdzas gzhan min zhes gleng / /phan tshun rdzas su grub par 'dod bzhin du/ /rdzas gcig rdzas gzhan gang du mi mthong ba/ /khyod kyi blo mig 'od zer 'phro ba de/ /phas rgol sgra gcan lag pas phrogs sam ci/ /rjes dpag rang myong nyid dang rdzas gcig pas/ /mngon sum spyi dang rdzas gcig bshad bzhin du/ /tsan dan shing dang rdzas gcig min smra ba/ /khas blangs 'khor gsum log pa ma tshor ram/ /rdzas gcig kun la grub sde rdzas gcig gis/ /khyab par smra ba rjes dpag mngon sum dang / /rtags gsal sbyar tshe 'khor gsum dngos 'gal du/ /bsnyon med gzugs su grub pa ma gzigs sam/ /pha rol 'gog tshe cha med rtags su sbyor/ /rang lan bzlog tshe rdzas gcig rnam dbye mkhas/ /pha rol ldog rjes rang la mi 'khor ba'i/ /gnad 'gag shes pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i drin/ /cha med rdzas gcig grangs can cha bsdus lugs/ /'jug tshe gzugs sogs spyi zhes khas blangs kyang / /'chad tshe spyi la snang sel 'byed shes pa/ /sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs lo tsā kho na'i lugs/ /tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi dka' 'grel gnad kyi snying po gsal byed las/ /spyi dang bye brag brtag pa ste rab byed gsum pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o/

/'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ṭi tas/ /byin rlabs snying la zhugs de nas/ /rnam dpyod blo mig gsal ba can/ /klu sgrub kho bo'i legs bshad yin/ /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ rigs gter gyi rab byed gsum pa'i rnam bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
